title: Package Expiry Runway and Appointment Series Portal Bookings — Questions Answered
content:
Training questions on how the expiry date of the funding Self-Pay Visit Package limits a package portal booking on an Appointment Series.

**The rule.** The package portal expiry limit is the maximum appointments in one booking of the series' format where the funding package's expiry date is more than 90 calendar days after the booking date, 6 appointments where it is more than 30 but no more than 90 days after, and 4 appointments where it is 30 days or fewer after.

**Which date is read?** The expiry date on the funding Self-Pay Visit Package, counted in calendar days from the booking date.

**What is the format's maximum appointments in one booking?**

| Visit format | Maximum appointments in one booking |
|---|---|
| Telehealth 30-Minute Visit Series | 12 |
| Standard 45-Minute Visit Series | 12 |
| Extended 60-Minute Visit Series | 12 |
| Aquatic Therapy Visit Series | 8 |
| Specialty One-on-One Visit Series | 8 |
| Post-Operative Priority Visit Series | 18 |

**The package expires exactly 90 days after the booking date — what limit?** 6 appointments. At 91 days it is the format's maximum.

**Exactly 30 days?** 4 appointments. At 31 days it is 6.

**A package whose expiry date has already passed?** 30 days or fewer: 4 appointments.
